tests.scope: Tiny synthetic snapshots and exact retained source/count/report metadata; no current catalog or runtime closure

reviewed_invariants: Only reviewed source adapters can admit the exact Uiua fannkuch, retained Uiua, R and APL candidates; source bytes/counts and native sample ownership join immutable saved metadata.
One successful snapshot pair can contain ordered canonical-LOC rebases for several workloads; time and formatted baselines, raw counts, source bytes, samples and unrelated metadata remain preserved.
Per-pool additions separate selected programs from full inventory. Every admitted x/y and nested publication snapshot is independently recomputed.

Each originally positive coordinate, including nonselected inventory rows, remains positive and belongs to its complete change inventory. Null or absent coordinates cannot be silently introduced or promoted.
Current admitted endpoint groups equal their latest successful exact groups; equal-valued alias selectors and duplicate endpoint identities cannot bypass snapshot preservation.
Existing-language coverage expansion is explicitly recorded through aggregate_change; x and y aggregates are recomputed and unrelated aggregate metadata is retained.
History binds applied success bytes and original before/after snapshots in admission order. The in-memory reverse view changes derived canonical x only and retains separately admitted coverage.
Current admitted raw records/source bytes and aggregate metadata remain bound before reverse replay; every recorded positive row must still exist.
The separate exact APL metadata review preserves the original false candidate flag, joins all eleven source/runtime/command/environment bindings and limits approval to declared static metadata.
fixed_findings: Missing-versus-null preservation checks for original metadata.
Current admitted endpoint groups were previously not bound to successful snapshots.
A positive nonselected old inventory coordinate could previously become null and evade the change audit.
remaining_requirements: Replay actual candidate closures and perform guarded preview/apply after the timing lane is free.
Independently verify the completed real snapshots/history and normal repository outputs before publication.

earlier_independent_review.scope: Earlier source revision reviewed independently before the final coordinate-availability repair; not the final 23-test verification
